tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gsang thig skor bdun bka' srung ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i phrin las bzhugs so//

hūm̐: mkha' dbyings bde chen dag pa'i zhing: lhun grub dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong: me rlung khrag mtsho ro gdan dbus: bhyoḥlas dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: nam mkha'i mdog can 'jigs pa'i gzugs: spyan gcig 'khor 'das dus kun gzigs: tshems gcig nyams pa'i srog la gzir: ral gcig mi mngon dbyings su 'bar: srid zhir mi gnas brkyang bskum bsgrad: g.yas g.yon zhing dbyug dgra snying bsnams: sbrul lnga rin chen rus rgyan spras: ba spu'i rtse nas me dpung 'bar: me 'bar klong nas lcags spyang 'gyed: sdig can sha khrag dmar g.yos byed: ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dregs pa'i tshogs: 'bum phrag grangs med 'khor dang bcas: snang stong rig rtsal rol par bskyed: thugs las 'od 'phros ye shes pa: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir sa mā dza: bhyo: ma skyes kun bzang dbyings nyid las: bde chen rol pa khros pa'i yum: sngags bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: bstan pa srung phyir 'dir gshegs shig: badzra sa mā dza: dam tshig sprul pa'i ngo bo nyid: gdod nas ye shes 'khor lor rdzogs: gnyis med bde chen rol par bzhugs: rdo rje'i dam tshig rjes dgongs shig: dbyings rig gnyis med brda phyag 'tshal: phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga: gsang ba'i dam rdzas dbang lnga'i mdangs: tshil chen spos dang zhun chen me: khrag zhag dri mchog sha chen bshos:

rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i sgra: dug gsum bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: khyad par thabs mchog a mṛ ta: shes rab bde ba'i dmar chen rgyun: gnyis med rol pa ba lingta: sbyor dang sgrol ba'i pū dza che: rten rdzas sgrub rdzas skong ba'i rdzas: dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa las: byung ba'i mkha' 'gro dgyes mchod sprin: ma tshang med pa 'dod dgu'i gter: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang ba 'bul: dgyes mchod bzhes la dngos grub stsol: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa dbyings su bskang: dam tshig bzhin du bdag srung zhing: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang: tshe dpal longs spyod snyan grags spel: mos pa thams cad 'du ba dang: gnod pa'i dgra bgegs med par mdzod: khyad par zab gsang bstan pa srungs: de 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe srings: bstan la gnod pa'i sdig can gang: mngon spyod las kyis myur du sgrol: mdor na ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin: phrin las thogs pa med par sgrubs: bhyo: gsang ba yum gyi bha ga'i klong: mtshan ma'i skyon bral sku gsung thugs: rtag pa 'gyur med bde chen rgyan: rgyan gyi rgyal mo'i gtso la bstod: snang srid dbyings rdzogs gtso mo'i mkha': mkha' dbyings dag pa'i cho 'phrul las: 'das dang ma 'das sprul pa'i gzugs: sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul can la bstod: thugs kar mi 'gyur srog yig mthar: 'bum phrag ḍā ki'i srog snying 'khor: bdag nyid thugs ka'i 'od kyis bskul:
gang bcol las kun myur sgrub
oṃ trag raksha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa:

bsnyen sgrub dril sngags ci nus bzla: phrin las sham bu gang 'dod bsgyur: rgyun du mchod cing dam tshig bzung: des ni bran bzhin the tshom med: sa ma ya: ma mo thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: mthun rdzas mchod gtor bzang du bsham: sngags rgya ting nge 'dzin gyis brlab:

hūm̐ bhyo: ma skyes kun bzang dbyings kyi yum: bde chen rol pa ḍā ki'i gtso: dpal ldan mkha' 'gro sprul 'khor bcas: dgyes bskang phrin las grub par mdzod: 'khor 'das dbyings kyi thig ler 'khyil: ma skyes 'gag pa med pa ste: 'di yang dgyes pa'i dam tshig che: gnyis med ngang du thugs dam bskang: mkha' klong bde ba'i cho 'phrul las: thams cad tshims byed 'dod rgu'i gter: snang srid mchod pa'i bye brag gis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: phyi mchod nyer spyod rnam lnga dang: gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i nor: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung gis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: nang mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: phud dang spyan gzigs longs spyod tshogs: rmad byung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gyis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: khyad par drag po'i 'dod yon che: sha khrag rus pa'i phung po dang: mthun pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: gsang ba sman gtor rakta dang: sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs mchog chen po: srog 'khor bla rdo bcas pa yis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: yang gsang bde chen mnyam pa'i dbyings: bskang bya skong byed mtshan ma bral: rang rig gdod nas rnam dag pas: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: mdor na dgyes dgu'i 'dod yon tshogs: mchod rdzas rten skong sgrub pa'i rdzas:

phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyis: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: khyed rnams thugs dam gnyan bskangs nas: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyis: so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig las: tshor dang ma tshor nyams pa dang: sgo gsum bag med las dbang gis: mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i las bgyis pa: thams cad ma lus bshags shing bsdom: 'gyod bshags dang du bzhes nas kyang: phrin las thams cad 'grub pa dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: ma g.yel ma 'da' mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam skongs rkyen zlog bsam pa sgrubs: bstan pa srung zhing skyong ba dang: 'jig rten kun tu bde legs spel: mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba dang: mthun rkyen legs tshogs rgyas par spel: gzhi byes dus kun rtag srung zhing: bcol ba'i las 'di grub par mdzod:

de ltar bshags skong rgyun du 'bad: ma mo 'khrugs pa zhi ba dang: 'dod pa'i phrin las 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang thig bka' srung chen mo yi/ phrin las spar gyi nor bu ni// dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas// bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dgung snyegs shog /dge'o// //
